items.note: N1 states the lemma as the paper does (forward invocation adds x to y, three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), scratch restored) and the method follows the subtract/compute/restore schedule and the forward-inverse-forward composition. The essential coefficient check (central |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling the rest, lines 752-759) is only alluded to as 'intersection-size coefficients', and h=100, triples and the neighbour rule are absent.

N2 gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, and the invariant plus commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, as at 804-817. The per-route epsilon_w form is covered only as 'only the endpoint frames matter'.

Nested nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3}, only central 3->4 edges decreasing by h, and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are stated. The budget identity sum|Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is missing (N3 only says 'below W·m'), as are the neighbour orthogonality that makes the side labels nest and the F_2 orthonormal-basis clause. The method sketch does not carry the telescoping argument, so this counts as stated rather than derived.

Projections P_U on gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, the endpoint identity = I_m, s_b<W_b m with deficit N-2L_b, and the shear H<-H+D (C1.1.a) all match. The derivation omits the essential exception that the N source edges have rank one (2P_{U_a}) despite zero dimension change (1162-1165). That exception is why the deficit is N-2L rather than 2N-2L, and the plan's method claims rank = dimension change on every edge.

Kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m, weight additivity mod 4, odd weight of norm-one vectors, the 27k inverse factors fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z, and C^{⊗m} on every role all follow 1231-1315. The frame is given only as the phase i^{wt(P_Ux)}, without the H^{⊗m} conjugation, and the exact s_c = W_c m-2N+2L_c is not given.

The chain L/N<1/2 (N3.2), deficit N-2L_b>0 (N4.1), and deficits >20·2^{-50} giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} (N6) is present. The exact η values and the use of log m<20 are not given, and N6 is an inference with no method, so this is stated, not derived.

The split/scan/merge, cyclic row split and cut-and-remerge rotation methods follow 513-621. T2 drops the condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time, and T1 omits the two-digit permutation.

Factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, triangular factors as controlled shifts, and one interchange per pivot via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j, exactly as in the paper.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, shear frames on edges by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^τ), and the parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node all match 1491-1615.
High digits supply a row field of range at least W^k, padded, the remaining width split in base m, and binary ranges padded to [q^e], as in 1649-1734.

Conjugation by P_M, s_c forward children on f=e/m axes, inverse children via C^{-1}=-iZCZ, row additions for M, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D all follow the paper. L1's phrase 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' conflates the m slots with the s_c calls.

Eight rotations composing (00 01 10) and (01 10 11), each a single cyclic shift done by swap, shift, unswap; the bad set via guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11] with fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}; repair by radix sort; the top position by a two-bit XOR; and cost O(V(L^τ+1)). All match 2013-2231.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), q_0 row chunks padded to W^{k_0}, u=Wg+w, the recurrence with ratio s/W, and the base-m piece sum giving O(d^{λ'}) are present. L2.3 drops the leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^β and their contribution O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), and claims the whole recurrence is O(e^λ). The condition max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)}<λ' is not stated.

O(Vd^{λ'}) layer, exact evaluation with Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, εC_1<1 giving Δ=o(p), and one truncation with error <√2·2^{-p} because rows of H have absolute sum one. All match the paper.

Character cancellation by pairing, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed stored order, the layout L of prefix moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, error √2 ℓ 2^{-p}, and cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{τ-1}+ℓ d^{λ'}]) match.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products, centered residues with |h_j|<B_0/2, negacyclic reduction, O(rp log(rp)). Matches.

Retained LB order (the pointwise product commutes with the record permutation), signed-packing products, the opposite transform, an exact scale by M, error 3δ+η before scaling, and the stated cost and error all match.
TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, ||N-I||<1/2, left inverse D N^{-1} C, contractions A and B_0, cited ordered maps, then tensoring with axis exposure by chunk swaps at O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^τ)). Matches.
Bluestein identity by coefficient comparison, and RF^+R=F^+ by dilation substitution with the convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2. Matches.
All fixed exponents, b, p, d, K, T, t_i, α and γ are given, and the prime search follows the paper. The value η=1/(4d) is never stated (A2 uses η unspecified), and r=2^{Θ(p^{1-ε})} is absent.

μ_i as inverses of prefix products, algebra isomorphism, triangular updates from i=d down to 1 by prefix-controlled shifts, and O(d^2) axis moves, at the stated cost. The explicit formula b_i is paraphrased as dependence on lower-index digits.

The source transform as A, chirp, then B_0 scaled by 2^γ, with the opposite one by conjugation, and the algorithm sequence with the two occurrences of S explained. Matches 4456-4544.
E_s=9·2^γ TL, norm <.501, (3E_s+2)h_p, final error <448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, and carries below Q_0^2 with the invariant. Matches.
Table normalized by Tp, margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2κ, log factors absorbed by p^κ, schoolbook below a cutoff. Matches.

errors.says: Edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change (implicitly on every edge).
errors.paper: The N source edges of X_a are exceptions: the first edge matrix is 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero; this is why s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b rather than W_b m-2N+2L_b.

errors.says: The phase frames are i^{wt(P_Ux) mod 4}.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U=H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}; it is the Hadamard conjugation that turns each residual factor into a translation kernel aI+bX_v.

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: For each edge, one child (C^{ε_h})^{⊗f} on slot h for h=1..ρ_edge after P_M^{-1}; the m slots are reused, and s_c is the total number of children over the whole network.

errors.says: With a=s/W<m^λ the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^λ) (also using τ(1+c/β)<λ and K<=e^{c/β}); leaves with F(e)=O(e) for e<d^β contribute O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is why λ' must exceed σ+β(1-σ).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, bit and complex interfaces, the strict saving s<Wm and τ=1-2^{-50}, the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, the phase-frame layer with packed row additions, synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling, chirp, CRT, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the label budget: the identity Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the triple/h=100 setup and the rank-one source-edge exception are never stated, so the deficit N-2L_b appears without its derivation. The layer recurrence's leaf term is also dropped in L2.3.

steps.note: The plan gives the gate types, the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and scratch restoration, but never h=100, the indexing by triples, N=C(h,3)^3 or m=h^3. Judged conservatively as mentioned.
Common frame commuting with pointwise gates, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, edge cost D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, only central 3->4 edges decreasing by h.
N4's method says edge differences are projections of rank equal to the dimension change, but it omits the N rank-one source-edge exceptions that the step requires. Judged conservatively as mentioned.
N3 only says the total dimension change is below Wm, and N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b. The identity sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is never stated.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, hence s<Wm.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m with P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and the shear H<-H+D on every row.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a rank-a edge makes a recursive calls and the node makes s calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits >20·2^{-50} giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, F_k=O(e^τ). The log m<20 step is left implicit.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the second half of the central chain well: frames, labels, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. It is weak on the quantitative bridge in between. The concrete network (h=100, triples, N, m), the rank-one source-edge exception and the budget identity Wm-2N+2L are absent, so the deficit N-2L_b is asserted but its origin is not reconstructed.
